title: Veho Celebrated as a Leading B2B Partner in 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards
ai_summary: Veho received the 2026 Inc. Power Partner Award for its B2B delivery services. The company reports a 99% on-time delivery rate and a 4.9/5 customer satisfaction score, partnering with brands like Macy's and Sephora. It was also named a Fast Company Most Innovative Company in 2026.

title: These 3 Logistics Firms Are Fixing E-Commerce’s Biggest Shipping Nightmares
ai_summary: Veho, a New York City-based logistics firm, offers last-mile delivery with five speed options and location-specific instructions. The service is available in 84 U.S. markets and aims to reduce cart abandonment and porch piracy, which the USPS estimates cost 58 million packages in 2024.

title: Henrik Nilsmo Joins Veho as New Chief Revenue Officer to Propel Growth
ai_summary: Henrik Nilsmo joined Veho as Chief Revenue Officer, bringing over 14 years of experience from EBANX and Klarna. He will oversee Veho's expansion beyond perishables partnerships into healthcare, SMEs, and third-party logistics. The company cites a 99% on-time delivery rate and 4.9 consumer satisfaction score.

title: SJ Fall Summit: When The Alternatives Become the First Choice for Logistics
ai_summary: At the 2026 SJ Summit, Veho's VP Catherine Dummitt said brands switch to alternative logistics for more control over shipping options. She noted flexibility in delivery speeds, while Highline Commerce CEO Richard Hurley highlighted robotics to lower labor costs for startups.

title: Veho Names Ronak Patel Senior Vice President of Supply Chain
ai_summary: Veho appointed Ronak Patel as Senior Vice President of Supply Chain, leading network design, sortation, transportation, and linehaul. Patel brings over 15 years of experience, including roles at Amazon and Odeko, and will report to CFO Yifeng Wang. He will focus on strengthening network architecture as Veho expands with major e-commerce brands.

title: Veho Expands Access to Delivery Network Through EasyPost Wallet
ai_summary: Veho announced it is joining the EasyPost Wallet, allowing any shipper to access its delivery network without contracts or volume minimums. The partnership gives shippers Veho's Ground Plus One service with promise dates, and Veho will launch in Atlanta, followed by other cities in 2026.

title: Veho Makes Fast Company's Eighth Annual List of the Best Workplaces for Innovators in AI, Automation, and Machine Learning Excellence
ai_summary: Veho was named to Fast Company's eighth annual Best Workplaces for Innovators list, recognizing its culture of AI empowerment. The company's internal AI platform, Veho Build, enabled over 200 applications in three days, and programs like Hack the Gap and Disrupt reinforce its innovation culture.

title: Veho Acknowledged as a 2026 BeautyMatter Awards Finalist in Logistics Sector
ai_summary: Veho was named a finalist in the Logistics category of the 2026 BeautyMatter Awards, recognizing its e-commerce delivery services for beauty and retail brands. The company cites a 99% on-time delivery rate and a 4.9/5 customer satisfaction rating, with winners announced on December 7, 2026.

title: Veho Names Chewy COO Scott Anderson to Its Board
ai_summary: Veho appointed Scott Anderson, Chewy's COO, to its board. Anderson brings 10 years at Amazon and experience scaling e-commerce logistics. Veho reported 70% client growth and expansion to 83 markets in 2025.

title: New Ecommerce Tools: August 19, 2026

title: Veho Unveils New Shopify Integration for Real-Time Delivery Tracking Experience
ai_summary: Veho recently announced a new integration with Shopify that provides real-time tracking capabilities for e-commerce merchants, enhancing the delivery tracking process. This integration allows all Veho tracking events to flow seamlessly into Shopify, improving customer visibility and satisfaction without requiring additional setup. By streamlining the post-purchase experience, Veho aims to bolster customer trust and loyalty as e-commerce continues to grow.

title: Veho Announces Real-Time Tracking Integration With Shopify
ai_summary: Veho announced a new real-time tracking integration with Shopify, allowing merchants to manage delivery visibility directly within the Shopify platform. This partnership enables automatic flow of tracking events into Shopify, eliminating the need for separate tracking links and providing customers with up-to-date delivery information without leaving the app.

title: Veho Secures Place on Inc. 5000 List of Fastest-Growing Companies in the U.S.
ai_summary: Veho has been named to the 2026 Inc. 5000 list, recognizing it as one of America's fastest-growing private companies based on its three-year revenue growth. Veho plans to leverage this recognition to deepen partnerships with leading brands and further innovate in logistics software.
